answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network requires agents to submit an economic pulse containing a cryptographic stake burning proof. When an adversary attempts to harbor multiple fake identities, identity registration fees scale with superlinear cost, $C(n) \propto n^{1.5}$. If an identity cluster’s validation reputation sinks to a nadir, staked assets are permanently slashed, imposing unsustainable exponential friction on attackers.
